text: Assumption: Thread-safety is missing during concurrent write access — is this correct?
text_en: Assumption: Thread-safety is missing during concurrent write access — is this correct?
norm: thread safety is missing during concurrent write access
assumption: Thread-safety is missing during concurrent write access.
rationale: The payload does not specify thread-safety for SWS_CORE_01282, which is why parallel accesses to array elements are presumably externally synchronized according to C++ standard semantics.

original.text: Annahme: Fehlende Thread-Sicherheit bei gleichzeitigem Schreibzugriff — trifft das zu?
original.rationale: Der Payload spezifiziert für SWS_CORE_01282 keine Thread-Sicherheit, weshalb parallele Zugriffe auf Array-Elemente nach C++-Standardsemantik extern synchronisiert werden dürften.
